name: hooksounds
description: Find music and sound effects for a project, compare previews, save them to your HookSounds playlists, and download with your account.

interface.longDescription: Find music, sound effects and intros from a project brief, compare previews, and choose versions such as shorter edits or mixes without melodies. Sign in with your HookSounds account to save sounds to your playlists and download them.
defaultPrompt: Find five warm, optimistic instrumental tracks for a morning routine video.
Find sound effects for a rainy city scene.
Help me build a soundtrack shortlist for this creative brief.

positive.description: Find music from a creative brief, without signing in
positive.prompt: Find five warm, optimistic instrumental tracks for a morning routine video.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the HookSounds catalog and shows up to five instrumental tracks in the inline panel, with cover art, playable previews and metadata such as genre, mood and length. The answer only recommends what the results show. No sign-in is needed.

positive.description: Find sound effects for a scene, without signing in
positive.prompt: Find sound effects for a rainy city scene.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches sound effects and shows a shortlist such as rain, thunder, traffic and city ambience, with playable previews in the inline panel. No sign-in is needed.

positive.description: Choose a version of a track for a target length
positive.prompt: I need about 30 seconds of upbeat corporate music for an ad. Which version of a good track should I use?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds an upbeat corporate track, lists its versions (for example the main version and shorter edits) with their durations, and recommends the version closest to 30 seconds. The panel shows the track with each version playable.

positive.description: Save a track to the account's Liked Tracks, signing in when asked
positive.prompt: Find a calm piano track for a meditation video and save it to my Liked Tracks.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a calm piano track. Saving needs an account, so ChatGPT asks to connect HookSounds; after signing in with the review account on the HookSounds consent page, the track is saved to Liked Tracks and the answer confirms it. The track then appears in Liked Tracks at https://www.hooksounds.com/playlists/.

positive.description: Download a track with the account's subscription
positive.prompt: Get me a download link for a lo-fi hip hop track for my YouTube vlog.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a lo-fi hip hop track and returns a download link for it. The review account has an active subscription, so the download is allowed; the answer notes that it uses the account's subscription and counts toward its plan limits. The panel shows the track with a Download button.

negative.description: Buying a subscription: the plugin doesn't sell plans, show prices or start checkout, so it should not act on this request.
A commercial song from another label: HookSounds only offers its own catalog, so the plugin must not claim to have or download this song.
negative.prompt: Download Blinding Lights by The Weeknd for my video.

negative.description: An unrelated request: nothing to do with music or sound, so the plugin should not be used.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Montevideo today?

review.commerce_description: The plugin doesn't sell anything. Existing HookSounds customers can sign in to use the subscription or licenses they already have. When a download isn't covered, the plugin says what the account needs and links to the informational plans page.

publication.release_notes: First release: find music, sound effects and intros from a brief, compare previews and versions in an inline panel, save sounds to HookSounds playlists, and download them with your HookSounds account.
